title: Birdwatching Society Junior
setting: The child joined a birdwatching society's junior outings in the wetlands. An adult volunteer who leads the walks messages about sightings and the next outing.

title: Classmate's Parent Carpool
setting: The child gets a lift to Saturday orchestra with a classmate. The classmate's parent, who drives, messages the child directly about pickup times because the classmate keeps forgetting.
